conflicts.description: The visible 2IIM 2024 Slot 1 DILR PDF begins with a DILR set numbered Set 7 about allocating stars, while GradeScale calls the tournament schedule Set 1. These are source-local set labels, not yet normalized; direct question correspondence remains to be mapped.

The sampled CAT 2024 Slot 1 VARC PDF page header identifies CAT 2024, but the bottom footer labels the displayed question as an Original CAT 2021 Question Paper. Treat as a possible reused/incorrect footer and inspect the full file before asserting paper authenticity/completeness.
Existing research records AglaSem's index as listing fewer CAT 2020 and 2022 slots than 2IIM. The slot model is a secondary archive candidate model, not a reconciled official census.

Existing CAT 2025 source records retain cross-provider question-number disagreements, including QA numbering; preserve source-local locators in legacy_id rather than force a canonical official number.

Existing audit records a Slot 1 QA explanation calling 628 the minimum where 268 is smaller and valid; the final factor-count answer coincides. It also records a reversed inequality in the Slot 2 DILR explanation; the answer is supported after correcting the relation. These are source-solution defects, not proven answer-key disagreements.
The Indian Express CAT 2025 analysis lead says 66 total questions while its sectional table and IMS analysis say 68 (24/22/22). No official response sheet has resolved this reporting discrepancy.

The three explored CETKing/CATKing direct PDF URLs returned HTML pages (including 404 pages) rather than PDF bytes. They remain search-result leads only; TheCATExam provides a separate accessible CAT 1991 page.

The first VARC-labelled sentence-correction item appears to offer both a plural predicative complement and a singular complement after a singular subject. This may be conventional grammar nuance or a genuine multiple-answer ambiguity; no answer key or editorial resolution was inspected, so it is not approved as a solved item.
